name: Influencer Marketing Deal Desk
tagline: Prices and structures creator deals before you reply to the brand
description: Bring it an inbound rate card, a campaign brief, a draft agreement or a budget, and it returns a recommendation, a fair price range, a deal shape that fits and the move to make next. It covers sponsorship work on YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X and LinkedIn, and only ever drafts: nothing sends until you approve it.
author: itsmattreichard
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
